$comment: Three containers with functions inside them and one module beside them, and three configured groups nobody belongs to yet. The checkout is deliberately not registered, which is why no part carries a binding: the author registers it before it can bind one. Every call lands on the function the source calls: flask run loads the app through ScriptInfo and hands it to werkzeug's run_simple, which serves it back into wsgi_app.

nodes.name: WSGI entry
nodes.responsibility: Flask.wsgi_app: pushes the request context, then dispatches

nodes.name: Dispatch
nodes.responsibility: Flask.full_dispatch_request: preprocesses, dispatches to the view, then finalizes

nodes.name: Finalize request
nodes.responsibility: Flask.finalize_request: makes the response, then post-processes it

nodes.name: Process response
nodes.responsibility: Flask.process_response: runs after_request functions and saves the session

nodes.name: Run command
nodes.responsibility: flask run: loads the app, then serves it

nodes.name: App loader
nodes.responsibility: ScriptInfo.load_app: imports the module and returns the application

nodes.name: Contexts
nodes.responsibility: The request and application contexts in src/flask/ctx.py

nodes.name: Request context push
nodes.responsibility: RequestContext.push: binds request and session for one request

nodes.name: Session interface
nodes.responsibility: Opens and saves the signed cookie session

nodes.name: Development server
nodes.responsibility: werkzeug run_simple serves the loaded application

edges.label: open_session
edges.description: RequestContext.push opens the session while it binds the request

edges.label: environ, start_response
edges.description: run_simple calls the application object, whose __call__ hands the request to wsgi_app
